parameters.help_en: The ID of the Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云容器服务Kubernetes版的Kubernetes集群的ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster type. Valid values: ACK, ASK, cloud-product-prometheus, and Node. You can query the dashboard list of a virtual cluster by specifying the cluster type. For InfluxDB-based cloud services, set this parameter to `cloud-product-prometheus`
parameters.help_zh: 集群类型，包括：ACK、ASK、cloud-product-prometheus和Node。虚拟集群可通过集群类型查询大盘列表。InfluxDB类云产品统一传`cloud-product-prometheus`
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en: The language of the returned Grafana dashboards. Valid values: en and zh. Default value: en
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回的Grafana大盘的语言，参数值包括en 、 zh ，默认值为en
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The title of the dashboard. The title may change. Use DashboardName for queries
parameters.help_zh: 指定大盘标题。大盘标题可能会修改，建议使用DashboardName查询
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud service. This parameter is optional. It is required when `clusterType` is set to `cloud-product-prometheus`. Supported cloud services include SAE, MSE, RocketMQ, Lindorm, Kafka, ClickHouse, DLA, MSMQ (ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ), ApsaraDB for MongoDB, Time Series (timing) Database (TSDB) for InfluxDB, MSE Cloud-native Gateway, Grafana Service, Distributed Scheduling Platform SchedulerX, MSE Global Transaction Service, Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS), Machine Learning Platform for AI (PAI-EAS), Application High Availability (active) Service (AHAS), and Performance Testing (PTS)
parameters.help_zh: 云产品Code，可选。当`clusterType=cloud-product-prometheus`时该字段必传。目前已经接入的云产品有：SAE、MSE、RocketMQ、Lindorm、Kafka、Clickhouse、DLA、消息队列RabbitMQ版、云数据库MongoDB版、时序数据库InfluxDB、MSE服务-云原生网关、Grafana服务、分布式调度平台SchedulerX、MSE服务-全局事务、企业级分布式应用服务EDAS、机器学习平台PAI-EAS、应用高可用服务AHAS、性能测试PTS
parameters.name: product

parameters.help_en: The switch parameter for creating or querying virtual clusters. This parameter is used to control compatibility with legacy data
parameters.help_zh: 创建或者查询虚拟集群开关参数，可以对老数据兼容控制
parameters.name: recreate_switch

parameters.help_en: The unique name of the dashboard. You can use this parameter to perform a filtered query for dashboards with specific names. Unlike the Title parameter, the name does not change. You can specify multiple names separated by commas (,), such as `k8s-event,k8s-overview`. A dashboard name may have multiple versions. To specify a version, you can increase the version information after the name, such as `k8s-event:v1,k8s-overview:latest`
parameters.help_zh: 大盘唯一名称，可筛选查询指定名称的大盘。相对于Title参数，Title可能会发生变化，name不会。并且支持指定多个name，以半角逗号（,）分隔，例如：`k8s-event,k8s-overview`。同一个大盘名称会有多个版本，如果要指定版本，可以在name后面增加版本信息，例如：`k8s-event:v1,k8s-overview:latest`
parameters.name: dashboard_name
